name: @nukhbapay/api
description: Minimal NestJS API foundation with process-liveness endpoint.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nukhbapay/api... -r build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.spec.js
scripts.test:identity:integration: pnpm --filter @nukhbapay/api... -r build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist-test/test/internal-staff-access.integration.js dist-test/test/staff-http.integration.js dist-test/test/local-api-runtime.integration.js dist-test/test/staff-persistence.integration.js dist-test/test/migration005.integration.js
